choice.basis: The chart shows a dual-axis line graph with 'United States' on the left y-axis (blue) and 'Canada' on the right y-axis (red). At the 2013 x-axis position, the blue circular marker (United States) is positioned vertically lower on the page than the red square marker (Canada). Because the chart uses separate y-axes for each country and provides no visible numerical tick labels or scale calibration on either axis, the vertical screen position alone does not establish a cross-country application-volume ordering. The exact numerical values for the 2013 data points are not explicitly labeled. Therefore, it is impossible to determine which country had the larger 2013 volume based on the visible evidence.
